decisions.subject: Under B′, unconverted update-tracked-projects.js gains the START_DATE_URGENT query in the classify_lifecycle_phase swap commit
decisions.recommendation: Operator-approved exception, narrowly scoped to this one alert move: the legacy, unconverted scripts/update-tracked-projects.js gains the START_DATE_URGENT query (CHAT-97.CLP-Q2-B2) in the same commit as the classify_lifecycle_phase swap (W3), so alerts never lapse. It is the first edit of an unconverted step inside another step's swap; no other legacy edit is licensed by it.

decisions.subject: The close_stale_permits fold lands at the permits ② / swap, keeping R-EN conditions (2)-(4)
decisions.recommendation: The close_stale_permits fold (R-EN) lands at the permits ② / swap instead of after load_permits ③ (amends R-EN condition (1)), keeping conditions (2)-(4). Condition (2), that the fold reads the loader's own seen-in-feed signal and never permits.last_seen_at, is now load-bearing for the swap order (PERMITS-MAP-VERIFY.md claim 3).

decisions.subject: The D-P1 readers move in the permits swap commit; the runner producer-read rides the bundled RE-FREEZE night
decisions.recommendation: The D-P1 readers (refresh_snapshot's sync_runs read and admin last_sync_at) move to pipeline_runs in the permits swap commit, with the runner producer-read on the bundled RE-FREEZE night, because the permits swap stops load_permits' sync_runs INSERT (scripts/load-permits.js:724-728) and only a manual runSync (src/lib/sync/process.ts:326-407) would still write it, so the readers would show misleading values. Amends R-II (b) and the CHAT-93.RS-1 note's 'lands with permits ③' timing.

decisions.subject: step-conformance computePairs also pairs a compute module with a registered manifest step
decisions.recommendation: A guard-test change, approved explicitly: src/tests/step-conformance.infra.test.ts §5.5 computePairs() (:673-685) also pairs a compute module with a manifest.scripts[*].file entry (a registered step not yet in a chain). A module with no manifest entry still fails, and a negative case proves it. References CHAT-94.P3-HOLD-1: a module whose step has no manifest entry is still held outside the tree.
